name: Iran nuclear programme
value: No IAEA access to bombed sites; ~440 kg at 60%
summary: IAEA cannot verify Iran's 440 kg of highly enriched uranium; no sign of rebuilding; no new strike on nuclear sites
state: IAEA Director General Grossi told the UN Security Council on 27 Oct that the agency cannot verify the whereabouts of about 440 kg of highly enriched uranium, that inspectors have not returned to sites hit in US strikes, and that remote monitoring shows no sign of rebuilding (Arab News). No strike on a nuclear site, NPT withdrawal or evidence of weaponisation was found as of 11 Nov.
for_you: This affects diplomacy and energy prices rather than direct public safety. Follow FCDO travel advice for Iran and the Gulf.
rubric_hit: 60% enrichment stock and inspector access curtailed = Watch

sources.title: Arab News — No sign Iran is rebuilding nuclear sites but 440 kg of uranium unaccounted for

why: A nuclear-armed Iran — or strikes to prevent one — could ignite the Gulf and send oil far higher.
drivers: Enrichment levels, IAEA access, Israeli/US military posture, snapback sanctions, talks.

rubric.alert: Strikes on nuclear sites, NPT withdrawal, or evidence of weaponisation.
rubric.watch: Enrichment at ≥ 60% or inspector access curtailed, or credible strike threats.
rubric.normal: IAEA access and active diplomacy; no escalation.
